lines.text: Now execute, the loop. We'll trace one moment, each line's value in grey at its end.
The robot is at zero, zero, facing zero degrees. The goal: three, zero, facing ninety.
Last loop we asked for two meters per second straight ahead, no spin. Twenty milliseconds have passed.
Lines one hundred sixty to sixty-two: d t, the time since last loop, then save the time. Zero point zero two seconds.
It's kept between a millisecond and a tenth of a second, in case a loop is skipped.
Line one hundred sixty-four reads the pose. Line one hundred sixty-five asks question one: goal.
Line one hundred sixty-six, the arrow to the goal: goal minus pose. Three, zero.
Line one hundred sixty-seven, question two: its length. Three meters.
Line one hundred sixty-eight, heading error: ninety degrees, one point five seven radians, wrapped between minus pi and pi.
